quote: Customer may extend for 36 months at fixed Extension Pricing by delivering written notice "not less than one hundred twenty (120) days before the end of the Initial Term" (§ 3.2). One hundred twenty days before December 31, 2026 is **September 2, 2026**. The SPA is dated September 21, 2026—nineteen days after the deadline. Unless Corbel already exercised the option before September 2, the Supply Agreement will expire at the end of the Initial Term, and the Company will have no contractual right to continue purchasing at the Extension Pricing.
